about: Library pages that deliberately have no picture slot, with the reason. The coverage test checks that every page has a slot or is listed here.

pages.glossary: An A-to-Z reference list; a picture would only decorate.
pages.examples: A hub of links to the example pages; a picture would only decorate.
pages.example-politics-da: Its core idea (limited capital forces a trade-off) is the same picture as the spending DA.
pages.example-economy-da: A long-chain picture would repeat the chain pictures on the DA and internal-links pages.
pages.example-consult-cp: Competition through certainty and timing is too abstract for one wordless picture.
pages.example-cap-k: Kritik pictures must not show the kritik's subject; the generic lens is already on the kritiks pages.
pages.example-fw-vs-k-aff: A generic picture would repeat the framework-vs-k-aff page.
